dataset_info.summary: Spoken European Portuguese recordings of voice-assistant commands from the Speech-MASSIVE corpus, with the written command as the reference. One row is one recorded command. These are short assistant-style utterances, the same kind of phrasing an OVOS device is asked to handle; their brevity means a single wrong word moves the error rate a long way. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
dataset_info.notes: Speech-MASSIVE Portuguese (pt-PT) test split — spoken voice-assistant utterances with transcripts, from the multilingual Speech-MASSIVE corpus.
